steps.title: Focused review
steps.blurb: Work through due and weak cards with Smart Check, prioritising the ones you keep missing. Nothing is due, so this works through weak and fresh cards instead.

steps.title: Final confidence pass
steps.blurb: One more quick pass. Multiple choice if you're short on time, self-check if you have a few extra minutes. Then stop for the day — sleep does more for recall than a late-night cram.

steps.title: Spaced review
steps.blurb: Work through everything due with Smart Check so your intervals stay honest. 4 cards due, about 2 min.

steps.title: Self-check quiz
steps.blurb: Confirm recall without leaning on the saved answer.

steps.title: Learn new cards
steps.blurb: Meet up to 2 new cards (2 waiting). Keeping new cards to a steady number stops tomorrow's reviews from piling up.

steps.title: Wrap up
steps.blurb: Look at what you got done and what's due tomorrow. Ending with a quick look back helps the session stick.
